verses.text: O LORD my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:

segments.text: O LORD my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:

verses.text: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.

segments.text: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending
it
in pieces, while
there is
none to deliver.

verses.text: O LORD my God, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;

segments.text: O LORD my God, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;

verses.text: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)

segments.text: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)

verses.text: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.

segments.text: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take
it;
yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.

verses.text: Arise, O LORD, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me to the judgment that thou hast commanded.

segments.text: Arise, O LORD, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me
to
the judgment
that
thou hast commanded.

verses.text: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.

segments.text: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.

verses.text: The LORD shall judge the people: judge me, O LORD, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity that is in me.

segments.text: The LORD shall judge the people: judge me, O LORD, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity
that is
in me.

verses.text: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.

segments.text: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.

verses.text: My defence is of God, which saveth the upright in heart.

segments.text: My defence
is
of God, which saveth the upright in heart.

notes: 7.10 My…: Heb. My buckler is upon God

verses.text: God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry with the wicked every day.

segments.text: God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry
with the wicked
every day.

notes: 7.11 judgeth…: or, is a righteous judge

verses.text: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.

segments.text: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.

verses.text: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.

segments.text: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.

verses.text: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.

segments.text: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.

verses.text: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.

segments.text: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch
which
he made.

notes: 7.15 He made a pit: Heb. He hath digged a pit

verses.text: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.

segments.text: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.

verses.text: I will praise the LORD according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high.

segments.text: I will praise the LORD according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high.

headings.text: Shiggaion of David, which he sang unto the LORD, concerning the words of Cush the Benjamite.
